mintAuthority.summary: spUSD is a role-gated BSC wrapper: the SoulPeg wrapper contract (0x0e8fb2e…) holds MINTER_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE on-chain; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by EOA 0xf683ab3…. MAX_SUPPLY is an immutable constant at 1B tokens.

controls.label: SoulPeg spUSD wrapper contract (MINTER_ROLE / BURNER_ROLE)
controls.capDescription: MAX_SUPPLY is a Solidity constant (uint256 public constant MAX_SUPPLY = 0x033b2e3c9fd0803ce8000000 ≈ 1B tokens); cannot be changed without redeployment.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103632643, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x0e8fb2e774b827711e0f86069931c1321113238e) returned true; hasRole(BURNER_ROLE, same) returned true. Wrapper is a contract (4417-byte code). BscScan contract source confirms mint() checks total supply < MAX_SUPPLY; MAX_SUPPLY is a Solidity constant, not a mutable variable — no setMaxSupply function exists.

controls.label: SoulPeg DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (EOA)
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103632643, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xf683ab3ac7dcb195a8df52d7f5fd796e81a75075) returned true; wrapper owner() returned the same address. eth_getCode on 0xf683… returned empty bytecode (EOA). Also confirmed that wrapper owner() returned 0xf683… independently.

controls.label: SoulPeg operator (sUSDC issuance + Venus routing)
controls.evidence: SoulPeg docs describe an operator that mints sUSDC 1:1 against deposited USDC, routes USDC into Venus lending, and runs a peg market-making bot; mint of the wrapped spUSD is gated behind this operator-controlled flow.

review.evidence: At BSC block 103632643: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, wrapper 0x0e8fb2e…) = true; hasRole(BURNER_ROLE, wrapper) = true; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, EOA 0xf683ab3…) = true; wrapper owner() = 0xf683ab3… (EOA confirmed via eth_getCode). MAX_SUPPLY() = 1,000,000,000 tokens (immutable constant, no setter function). SoulPeg (spUSD) is a BNB Chain protocol with no disclosed registered entity; its own documentation states the contracts have not undergone a formal third-party audit and no reserve attestation or proof-of-reserves is published (reserves are on-chain USDC routed into Venus lending), so reconciliation is unknown. No named financial regulator, charter, or registry entry for any SoulPeg entity was found, so supervision is none. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: immutable token logic enforces the 1 billion maximum supply, but the operator-controlled sUSDC/Venus route has no whole-supply reconciliation and no regulator or independent attestor is evidenced.
